# Zivel

> Zivel is a science-backed wellness franchise brand offering recovery, performance, and aesthetics services across 19 studio locations in the United States. Every service is selected based on peer-reviewed research and clinical evidence.

Tagline: Recover Smarter. Look Better. Feel Stronger.

Website: https://www.zivel.com

## Services

Zivel offers eight core service modalities:

- **Cryotherapy** — Whole-body cold exposure (2–3 min, ultra-low temperatures) for recovery, inflammation reduction, and energy. https://www.zivel.com/services/cryotherapy
- **Red Light Therapy** — Near-infrared and red wavelength light panels for cellular energy, skin health, and muscle recovery. https://www.zivel.com/services/red-light-therapy
- **Infrared Sauna** — Full-spectrum infrared heat for detoxification, cardiovascular support, and deep relaxation. https://www.zivel.com/services/infrared-sauna
- **Dry Float** — Zero-gravity pod sessions using Epsom salt solution for decompression, stress relief, and nervous system reset. https://www.zivel.com/services/dry-float
- **Cryo Slimming** — Non-invasive body contouring using controlled cold to target and reduce localized fat cells. https://www.zivel.com/services/cryo-slimming
- **Cryo Toning** — Thermal contrast technique alternating cold and mild warmth to firm and tone skin. https://www.zivel.com/services/cryo-toning
- **CryoLift Facial** — Cryo-based facial treatment reducing puffiness, tightening skin, and improving complexion. https://www.zivel.com/services/cryo-lift-facial
- **Compression Therapy** — Pneumatic compression sleeves for lymphatic drainage, circulation, and recovery. https://www.zivel.com/services/compression-therapy

All services index: https://www.zivel.com/services

## Wellness Pathways

Zivel organizes services into goal-based Pathways — curated multi-service programs aligned to specific outcomes:

- **Recovery** — Reduce soreness, support healing, and return to peak performance faster. https://www.zivel.com/pathways/recovery
- **Performance** — Optimize energy, endurance, and physical output. https://www.zivel.com/pathways/performance
- **Beauty** — Improve skin quality, tone, and facial appearance. https://www.zivel.com/pathways/beauty
- **Longevity** — Support cellular health, inflammation control, and long-term vitality. https://www.zivel.com/pathways/longevity

All pathways: https://www.zivel.com/pathways

## Memberships

Zivel offers membership plans that provide discounted access to services across all studio locations. Membership details and pricing vary by location.

Memberships: https://www.zivel.com/memberships
